title: Dos bloques
goal: Read how the post-1945 world split into US-led and Soviet-led blocs, the containment doctrine, and the nuclear arms race, and why Latin America became a particularly sensitive Cold War terrain.
grammar: Ya sea... ya sea: presentar dos opciones formales

items: Explain how the world divided after 1945.
State what both superpowers actively sought to do.
Explain what the arms race included.
Use ya sea... ya sea to present two formal alternatives without ranking them.
